title: code_index.rename_symbol request
description: Symbol-grounded cross-file edit driven by the typed symbol graph (#2434). Two modes share one atomic, syntax-validated, all-or-nothing machinery: (1) RENAME — supply `new_name`; every identifier-context occurrence of `symbol_ref.name` becomes the new identifier and the edit aborts if `new_name` already exists (shadow check). (2) REPLACE — supply `replacement_text`; every identifier-context occurrence is overwritten with arbitrary text (e.g. an API migration `oldFn` -> `client.newFn(`), skipping the identifier/shadow gates but still requiring the rewritten file to re-parse. Both modes never touch matching text inside strings or comments. Writes route through staged-fs (#1722) when `session_id` is supplied so all touched files succeed or none do; without a session id the host still buffers every edit in memory and only writes after pre-flight validation passes.

proof.description: Include bounded edit excerpts and per-file syntax evidence. Does not run a project check.

symbol_ref.description: Select one declaration by its exact indexed name or qualified alias and workspace-relative defining path. Optional 1-based line, UTF-16 name column and kind must all match that same declaration. Wrong selectors return no match; they never broaden the search. Use path '.' only for an explicit workspace-wide seed search.

name.description: Bare declaration name, or an exact qualified_name or receiver_qualified_name reported by the index, such as Store.load. Unknown owners do not match by suffix.

path.description: Exact workspace-relative defining file. A wrong or suffix-only path returns no match; '.' explicitly searches all defining files.

col.description: 1-based UTF-16 column of the declaration name, as reported by the index. Not a byte offset or wrapper/decorator position. Unavailable or mismatched position data returns no match.

new_name.description: Rename mode: the replacement identifier. Must match the per-language identifier syntax and must not equal `symbol_ref.name`. Required unless `replacement_text` is supplied.

replacement_text.description: Replace mode: arbitrary text that overwrites every true-identifier occurrence of `symbol_ref.name` (still skipping strings/comments). Use for symbol-grounded find/replace that is NOT a rename — e.g. an API migration `oldFn` -> `client.newFn(`. The identifier-validity gate and shadow check are skipped (a literal replacement cannot shadow), but the rewritten file must still re-parse when `validate` is true. When supplied, `new_name` is ignored.

scope.description: How widely to rewrite. `file` and `module` are aliases in the current graph (one Module node per file); `workspace` follows REFS edges across files.

session_id.description: Optional staged-fs session id. When supplied and the session is in `staged` mode, writes land in the overlay until commit.

backend.description: Which engine computes a rename. `auto` (the default, overridable with `HARN_REFACTOR_BACKEND`) asks the language's server and falls back to the syntax-tree engine when the server is missing or cannot answer; `language_server` never falls back; `syntax_tree` never starts a server. Replace mode always uses the syntax-tree engine.

dry_run.description: When true, validate end-to-end (parse, conflict, syntax) and return the planned edits without writing. Defaults to false.

validate.description: When true (default) every rewritten file is re-parsed; any tree-sitter ERROR/MISSING node aborts the edit with `result: "syntax_error"`.
